entries.1b95d3a4e28d132c: The company is headquartered in Fukuyama, Hiroshima Prefecture, and was founded as ADTEC Co., Ltd. in January 1985. It was listed in July 2004 on the Mothers market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, and is currently listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. The company operates through its own business, seven consolidated subsidiaries (six overseas companies in the United States, the United Kingdom, Vietnam, South Korea, Taiwan and China, and IDX Co., Ltd. in Sano, Tochigi Prefecture) and one equity-method affiliate. Consolidated employees as of August 31, 2025 numbered 523; in addition, there are on average 99 temporary employees for the year. The management philosophy is “QUICK,” formed from the initials of Quality, Unique, Innovative, Creative and Kind to the Earth; the securities report says the company aims to be the world's best in plasma high-frequency power supplies, measuring instruments and plasma sources.

entries.7dafdadb59a7ed7d: A business that designs, manufactures and sells power supplies and measuring instruments built into equipment for manufacturing semiconductors and liquid crystal panels, and also provides technical services; it is the core of the Group. The main products are high-frequency power supplies for plasma and matching units (automatic impedance matching devices) that match electrical conditions between the power supply and the equipment, and it also handles measuring instruments. In addition to the Company, six subsidiaries in the United States, the United Kingdom, Vietnam, South Korea, Taiwan and China are responsible for it; the subsidiaries in Vietnam and South Korea manufacture the Company's products, and the subsidiaries in the United States, the United Kingdom, Taiwan and China sell the Company's products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥11,328 million (up 7.5% from the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥1,702 million (up 16.2% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue of ¥12,680 million. The securities report states that orders from manufacturers of deposition equipment for displays and from semiconductor manufacturing equipment manufacturers, mainly overseas customers, were solid, while the order environment deteriorated rapidly from the third quarter onward owing to the effects of U.S. tariff policy and other factors.

entries.8c882809a2d3ac62: The Semiconductor and LCD-Related Business designs, manufactures and sells high-frequency power supplies for plasma, matching units and measuring instruments installed in manufacturing equipment used in semiconductor and LCD substrate manufacturing processes, and also provides technical services. The Research Institution and University-Related Business, through IDX, deals in DC power supplies, pulse power supplies, microwave power supplies and power supplies for superconducting electromagnets (coils) and others, for R&D in medical, environmental and materials science at research institutions and universities, and for general industrial use. The subsidiaries in Vietnam and South Korea manufacture the company's products, and those in the United States, the United Kingdom, Taiwan and China handle sales. The Vietnamese subsidiary has introduced additional sheet-metal processing machinery because its initiative to handle part of sheet-metal processing in-house is showing results. Group R&D expenses for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥769 million, of which ¥711 million was for the Semiconductor and LCD-Related Business and ¥57 million for the Research Institution and University-Related Business. R&D is centered on the design and development departments, and some is conducted as joint research with universities and other companies.

entries.b5dc6b85bf564fdf: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥12,680 million (up 12.2% year on year). The Semiconductor and Liquid Crystal Related Business recorded ¥11,328 million (up 7.5%) and the Research Institution and University Related Business ¥1,352 million (up 78.3%), both being revenue from external customers. Orders received totaled ¥11,117 million (up 18.0% year on year), and the order backlog at year-end was ¥4,255 million (down 26.9%). The Semiconductor and Liquid Crystal Related Business had orders received of ¥9,773 million and an order backlog of ¥3,289 million, and the Research Institution and University Related Business had orders received of ¥1,344 million and an order backlog of ¥965 million. entries.b63986d47345ed35: It is a corporate group consisting of the company and 7 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], and it has 2 [[term:segment|reporting segments]]. The other 1, the Research Institution and University-Related Business, is handled by subsidiary IDX Co., Ltd., which deals in DC power supplies, pulse power supplies and the like used by research institutions and universities for research and development. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, net sales to external customers were ¥11,328 million for the Semiconductor and Liquid Crystal-Related Business and ¥1,352 million for the Research Institution and University-Related Business, and most of consolidated net sales of ¥12,680 million came from the former. The annual securities report states that, because its principal customers are semiconductor-related companies, it is greatly affected by the semiconductor market.

entries.f95a831e287716f9: A business that designs, manufactures and sells power supplies used by research institutions and universities for research and development in medicine, the environment and materials science, as well as power supplies for general industrial use, and also provides technical services. It is carried out by the subsidiary IDX Co., Ltd. (98.8% of voting rights owned), which handles DC power supplies, pulse power supplies, microwave power supplies, power supplies for superconducting electromagnets (coils) and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,352 million (up 78.3% from the previous fiscal year) and operating profit was ¥37 million (operating loss of ¥52 million in the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that sales of power supplies for medical equipment, shipments of products for government agencies, power supplies for silicon wafer pulling equipment, maintenance services and others were solid, and that new orders for power supplies for medical equipment were also won. It also forecasts that government R&D budgets tend to be restrained.
entries.f9ed0a97ce8c1e75: For the fiscal year ended August 2025, operating profit was ¥1,808 million (up 21.8% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥1,897 million (up 17.7%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥2,007 million (up 65.3%), and the ordinary profit margin on revenue was 15.0% (14.3% in the prior year). Regarding the increase in operating profit, the annual securities report explains that it was mainly due to higher revenue in the Semiconductor and Liquid Crystal Related Business and improved production capacity utilization. Segment operating profit was ¥1,702 million for the Semiconductor and Liquid Crystal Related Business (up 16.2%) and ¥37 million for the Research Institution and University Related Business (operating loss of ¥52 million in the prior year). Net income includes a gain on changes in equity of ¥693 million (extraordinary income) arising when Adtec Healthcare Limited changed from a consolidated subsidiary to an equity-method affiliate, and this differs in nature from the increases in operating profit and ordinary profit from the core business.
